newsitem.title: USA: Rockwell sees 97 sales of about $8 billion.
newsitem.headline: Rockwell sees 97 sales of about $8 billion.

text.p: Rockwell International Corp, which earlier Monday announced plans to spin off its automotive component systems operations, projected fiscal 1997 sales of about $8 billion as it focuses on its three core businesses.
The company will have about 44,000 employees and operations in nearly 100 countries after a spinoff and the following core businesses:
-- Rockwell Automation, with projected fiscal sales of $4.5 billion, is the largest Rockwell unit and a supplier of industrial automation products to the North American market.

-- Rockwell Semiconductor Systems is a provider of semiconductor products for personal communications OEM customers, and is the world's leading supplier of fax and personal computer modem chipsets. Fiscal 1997 sales are projected to be about $1.8 billion.

-- Avionics & Communications is a supplier of Collins brand avionics and communications products for air transport (airlines/OEMs), regional aircraft, business aviation, and other commercial and government markets. Fiscal 1997 sales are projected to approach $1.7 billion.
